verdict.rationale: Twenty documents unlimited custom objects with 20+ field types and custom relations between any objects, including many-to-many. Custom objects get first-class treatment, with auto-generated REST/GraphQL endpoints, views, permissions and workflow triggers. Developers can change the schema programmatically through the Metadata API or define objects and fields as code via the CLI app framework. One community user calls the customization "very promising" but describes the product as alpha-quality, which is not concrete corroboration of custom objects and relations working in practice. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of custom object/relationship modeling in practice.
